title: Stack-pack descriptor
description: Structural contract for `skills/stack-packs/{name}/pack.yaml`. Describes what a stack pack covers, its archetype fit, pre-picks, and baseline coverage.

name.description: Pack identifier (e.g. `nextjs-convex`, `vibe-coder`). Must match the directory name.

archetype_fits.description: Scoring signals used by stack-discovery-sync pack-match rubric.

product_types.description: product_type values this pack is well-suited for.

pre_picked.description: Map of decision_area → chosen technology. User may override any key.

overrideable.description: All pack pre-picks are overrideable by the user. Always true.

baselines_out_of_box.description: Baseline categories this pack covers without additional env-provision steps.

quickstart_skill.description: Relative path to this pack's quickstart skill (no trailing slash).

testing.description: Test architecture this pack seeds into the project's testing.yaml, declared in the L0-L7 layer shape (schemas/testing.schema.ts) rather than as a free-text tool string (audit F6). Each present layer names the tools that run it.
